test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of ₹14,500 was invested at 9% per annum simple interest for few years. The interest accrued during this period was ₹7,830. What was the period of investment?
solution:
**Given, **

Principle (P) = Rs.14500 

Rate of interest (R) = 9% per annum 

Time period (T) =? 

Simple interest (S.I.) = Rs.7830 

**Formula used:** 

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100** **

**Calculation: **

7830 = (14500 × 9 × T)/100 

⇒ 7830 × 100 = (14500 × 9 × T) 

⇒ T = (7830 × 100)/(14500 × 9) 

⇒ T = 783000/130500 

⇒ T = 6 years.

**∴ The Time Period of the investment is 6 years.**
